prompt: Use case: product-mockup. ONE original photorealistic ghost-mannequin FRONT photograph of Women's Sports Bra in black #111111. Close fitting opaque scoop-neck sports bra, narrow adjustable straps, low straight back, broad smooth underbust band, matte fine stretch knit, removable internal cups not visible. Simple original seams, no contour shading. Tiny tonal MORAVEL at left front underbust hem, no rear logo. Invisible mannequin, no person or props. Entire garment dimensional athletic volume, isolated on plain cool light-grey #E5E7EB background, hard upper-left light, crisp shadow and high contrast with fabric detail. MORAVEL letters are small direct tonal ink, narrow spaced DIN Condensed-like uppercase, no patch, no bright white logo. No other text, brand or decorative seam signature. New photograph generated from text only. EXACT 4:5 canvas 1122x1402 pixels, full garment centered with generous margins. Not square, not collage.
